title: Act: Render PhaserHost with BootScene in the App scene slot
summary: Replace SceneView with PhaserHost in App.tsx.
description: Edit game/frontend/src/App.tsx so the GameLayout scene slot mounts PhaserHost with BootScene instead of SceneView, keeping ActionMenu, the Suggest button and ContributionSheet.
acceptance_criteria: Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then PhaserHost is rendered and SceneView is not.
Given the App file is read, when imports are inspected, then SceneView is no longer imported by App.tsx.

in_scope: game/frontend/src/App.tsx imports and scene slot JSX
preserve: Other App props, state and handlers

technical_constraints: PhaserHost and BootScene are existing exports

steps.action: Remove the SceneView import on L8 and add imports for PhaserHost from './components/PhaserHost' and BootScene from './phaser/BootScene'.
steps.code:
import { SceneView } from './components/SceneView';  ->  import { PhaserHost } from './components/PhaserHost';
import { BootScene } from './phaser/BootScene';
steps.expected: App.tsx no longer imports SceneView and imports PhaserHost and BootScene.

steps.action: Replace the <SceneView ... /> element (sceneId, title, objects, selectedId, onSelect props) with an absolutely positioned full-size wrapper containing <PhaserHost scenes={[BootScene]} />, leaving ActionMenu, the Suggest button and ContributionSheet untouched.
steps.expected: The scene slot renders the phaser-host element and no img or hotspot buttons.
